page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Running head at the top. Title block centred (heading, Greek epithet). Then the epigram in italic verse with a large initial G. Closing initials "C. R. JC." at right. Signature "b 3" and catchword "ALI-" at the foot.

l.i: Non aliâ pingi dextrâ quàm debuit istâ
Ille[?], cui nec erat vitâ conjunctior alter.
Sculptore[?], ab solo & pingi se edixit

page.notes: The large initial G is joined to "ermanus" as in the print. The Greek word "ἐπάσιχον" is doubtful in its accents and letters; the print reads roughly "ἐπἀσιχον". The mark after "Ille", "Sculptore" and "Apelle" is a printed elision or abbreviation stroke, which I could not read with certainty. "DÜRERUS" and "PIRCKEIMERUS" are copied as printed. No printed page number, only the signature "b 3". The margins carry no text.
